The Mayor sent me! Let me out!|The assassin, to Boba Fett|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''assassin''' served the [[Order of the Night Wind]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. Normally only allowed to operate within [[Hutt Space]], he and several other [[assassin]]s were sent to [[Mos Espa]] around [[9 ABY]] to [[Ambush outside of the Sanctuary|ambush]] [[Boba Fett]], the [[city]]'s self-appointed [[Daimyo]]. Their mission turned to failure, however, after most of their force was defeated by [[Master Assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]] and Fett's [[Gamorrean Warrior|Gamorrean guards]]. The sole surviving member, the Night Wind assassin was questioned by the [[crime lord]] as to the identity of his employer, to which he claimed to have been sent by [[Mayor of Mos Espa|Mayor]] [[Mok Shaiz]] of Mos Espa. When confronted by Fett, however, Shaiz simply thanked the Daimyo for bringing a member of the Night Wind to justice and had the assassin [[Death|executed]] on the spot. ==Biography== ===Assassination attempt=== {{Quote|Fennec! Alive.|Boba Fett advises Fennec Shand to bring an assassin back alive|}} [[File:AmbushOutsideSanctuary-BoBFCh1.png|thumb|left|300px|The Night Wind assassins press their attack on Fett and Shand.]] In [[9 ABY]], the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] worked as an [[assassin]] in the [[Order of the Night Wind]], an order of assassins who were only permitted to operate within [[Hutt Space]]. He and five other of the assassins were hired to [[Death|eliminate]] [[Boba Fett]], who had recently [[Attack on Jabba's Palace (Boba Fett)|seized]] the position of [[Daimyo]] of the [[desert]] [[Planet|world]]{{Databank|tatooine|Tatooine}} [[Tatooine]]. After Fett and his [[Master Assassin|master assassin]], [[Fennec Shand]], left the [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|Sanctuary]] [[cantina]] in the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]], the six assassins [[Ambush outside of the Sanctuary|ambushed]] the pair in the street, armed with [[plasma pike]]s and [[Ray shield|energy shields]]. The Night Wind assassins trapped their targets in a circular shield-formed enclosement which withstood an explosive counterattack from Fett, but they were soon flanked by the Daimyo's two [[Gamorrean]] [[Gamorrean Warrior|guards]], who were able to break the Night Wind's formation. [[File:FennecVsNightWind-BoBFCh1.png|thumb|right|300px|Fennec Shand faces down the assassin and his cohort on a Mos Espa rooftop.]] Fett, Shand, and their guards fought the assassins, killing three of them before the Night Wind assassin and his remaining two comrades chose to retreat and scrambled up a building. While Fett was able to destroy one of the fleeing assassins, Shand pursued the assassin and his last accomplice, who hopped across the buildings of Mos Espa. When Fett's master assassin caught up with the pair, they threw [[Knife|knives]] at her, forcing their adversary to jump off the building they were on to dodge the attack. The two assassins then continued to travel across more buildings until Shand once took them by surprise atop another building, engaging them in hand-to-hand. Fett's master assassin overpowered them, disarming the pair and using one of them batons to force them into surrender. Shand then kicked the assassin's comrade over the ledge, taking him prisoner alone. ===Prisoner of Fett=== {{Quote|We spared your life after you tried to take mine. And you curse me?|Fett, to the assassin|}} [[File:Night_Wind_Assassin_Captured.png|thumb|left|300px|The assassin was captured and brought to Fett's palace.]] Shand tied up the Night Wind assassin's wrists with a rope and took him back to Fett's [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]], where he was taken before the Daimyo. Fett questioned the assassin, asking who had sent him. The captive remained silent, though, so the Daimyo had [[Unidentified Gamorrean guard 2|one]] of his Gamorrean guards put a blade to the prisoner's throat, only for him to curse Fett in [[huttese]]. Fett's [[8D-series smelter droid]] [[8D8]] explained the assassin's affiliation with the Night Wind, claiming that he feared no man. Shand then wondered if the assassin feared a [[rancor]] and the captive looked up in fear before a trap door released under him, sending him into a dungeon. A large door near him began opening, and the assassin, believing a rancor was behind it, succumbed to his fear and claimed [[Mayor]] [[Mok Shaiz]] of Mos Espa had sent him to kill Fett. [[File:ShowdownInCityHall-BoBFCh2.png|thumb|right|300px|Mok Shaiz had the assassin shot by one of his guards.]] The Night Wind assassin had been fooled, as there was no rancor behind the door. Fett and Shand took him to the [[Mos Espa City Hall]] with the Gamorreans. Entering the building, Shand pulled the prisoner to his knees while Fett spoke to the [[Unidentified clerk|desk clerk]]. When Shaiz's [[Mok Shaiz's majordomo|majordomo]] stepped in and claimed the mayor was busy, the Daimyo forced his way into Shaiz's office, the assassin being pulled along with him. Pulling the captive to the floor once again, the Daimyo accused Shaiz of sending the assassin to kill him. Shaiz, identifying the prisoner as a Night Wind assassin, had one of his guards shoot the captive, giving the excuse that the Order of the Night Wind was not allowed to operate outside of Hutt Space. ==Personality and traits== [[File:NightWindAssassin-CGSWG.png|thumb|250px|right|The Night Wind assassin wielded a plasma pike.]] {{Quote|There is no way he will talk. They fear no man.''"
"''Fine. Perhaps he fears the rancor.|8D8 and Shand|}} A human male, the Night Wind assassin had [[Color|light]] skin and blue eyes. As a member of the Order of the Night Wind, he feared no man, even cursing at Boba Fett when there was a blade held to his throat. An exception, however, was a rancor, and the assassin quickly gave up information when he was tricked into believing a rancor was being released on him. ==Equipment== The assassin wore red [[clothing]] with silver [[armor]] over his chest, brown [[boot]]s and a black hood. He also donned a thick black [[belt]] and [[vambrace]]s, one of which produced an energy shield. The assassin wielded a [[plasma pike]]. ==Behind the scenes== The assassin first appeared in the [[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land|premiere episode]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which was directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]] and aired on [[December 29]], [[2021]].{{DisneyPlusYouTube|t9Ca4ARSfqA|Next On Disney+ | December 2021}} The character was portrayed by stunt performer [[Paul Darnell]]. ==Appearances== *{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}} {{1st}} *{{BOBF|Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified Night Wind assassin}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ღამის ქარის უცნობი ლიკვიდატორი |pt=Assassino da Ordem do Vento Noturno não identificado }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Order of the Night Wind members]]
